auditor_value: Three concurrent forces at the centre: weight W straight down; N₁ perpendicular to the left wall and N₂ perpendicular to the right wall, each directed toward the centre (no friction).
notes: The solution's force list matches mine and every stated reason is correct (a normal to a circular surface is radial, so all three lines pass through the centre; 'N₁ + N₂ balances W' is the vector sum). Both mistake entries are genuine errors.
